user.title: Hikvision Access Control
user.description: Connect to a Hikvision access control terminal. Create a user on the device with Remote: Parameters Settings and Remote: Log Search permissions.

error.insufficient_permission: The device refused the request. Check the user permissions.

add.title: Add person
add.description: Create a person on the terminal. Leave the employee number empty to allocate one automatically, and the PIN empty to generate a random one.

edit_form.title: Edit person

delete_confirm.title: Delete person
delete_confirm.description: Delete person {employee_no} from the terminal? This cannot be undone.

error.device_error: The device refused the request. Check the user permissions and the device log.
error.invalid_validity: Valid until must be later than Valid from.

abort.not_loaded: The device is not set up. Fix the setup error on the integration page first.
abort.no_persons: No persons are enrolled on the terminal.
abort.cannot_list: The device did not return the person list. Check that the account may read Remote: Parameters Settings, then try again.
